name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror Acrylic Badge Reel
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality mirror acrylic and transparent acrylic, creating a stylish and durable badge reel with a layered dimensional look.
    - Built with a 2-layer acrylic construction, giving the product a premium finish and eye-catching appearance.
    - Available in Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic options.
    - Each acrylic layer has a thickness of 3mm, offering a sturdy and reliable structure.
    - Comes with a functional badge reel attachment, including:
              +) Alligator clip
              +) Metal pushpin/snap strap
              +) Retractable reel cord
              +) Adhesive backing pad
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple size options:
              +) 1.57 x 1.57 in ~ 4 x 4 cm
              +) 1.97 x 1.97 in ~ 5 x 5 cm
              +) 2.36 x 2.36 in ~ 6 x 6 cm
    - Badge reel component dimensions:
              +) Reel diameter: 3.2 cm
              +) Total reel length: 8.2 cm
              +) Retractable cord length: 75 cm
              +) Adhesive area: ~2 cm
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving & Printing Technology:
    - This product uses precision engraving technology on mirror acrylic for sharp details and a refined finished look.
    - Available in 2 style constructions:
              +) Style 1:
                      -> Layer 1: Transparent Acrylic – 1-sided printing
                      ->Layer 2: Mirror Acrylic – Engraving 
              +) Style 2:
                      -> Layer 1: Mirror Acrylic – Engraving 
                      -> Layer 2: Transparent Acrylic – 1-sided printing
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a retractable badge holder for ID cards, access cards, name badges, and work passes.
    - Features an alligator clip on the back for secure attachment to clothing, pockets, belts, or lanyards.
    - Includes a metal pushpin / snap strap to hold your badge securely.
    - The 75 cm retractable cord makes it easy to scan, swipe, or present ID cards without removing the badge reel.
    - Suitable for teachers, nurses, office staff, students, medical workers, and anyone who uses ID badges daily.
    - Great for adding a personalized and decorative touch to uniforms or work accessories.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A fun and practical personalized gift for teachers, nurses, coworkers, students, and friends.
    - Perfect for back-to-school, graduation, office gifts, appreciation gifts, and daily work accessories.
    - Great for themed gifts, workplace personalization, and custom professional accessories.
    - A thoughtful choice for anyone who wants both functionality and personal style in one product.
    - Ideal for teacher gifts, healthcare staff gifts, office team gifts, and personalized event items 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 2-Layer Mirror Acrylic Badge Reel

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
